relationships.subject: CORM-2
relationships.evidence_quote: Our results showed that the increased expression of p-Akt caused by peripheral inflammation in the four analyzed brain areas was reversed by CORM-2 and CoPP therapies.

relationships.subject: CoPP
relationships.evidence_quote: CoPP also increased the expression of HO-1 on VHPC

relationships.subject: CoPP
relationships.evidence_quote: Both treatments also normalized the upregulation of BAX induced by CFA on the VHPC and MSA.

relationships.subject: CORM-2
relationships.evidence_quote: both treatments up-regulated the NQO1 levels on the PAG of CFA-injected animals

key_findings: CORM-2 and CoPP reversed CFA-induced p-Akt increases in PAG, amygdala, ventral hippocampus and medial septal area.
Both treatments normalized HO-1 decreases in PAG and AMG and raised NQO1 in PAG.
